content:
Hello!
Please tell me what to do if Lean InfoView isn't showing up? It's just blank!

I recently deleted one of the toolchain versions from the file manager...

Does restarting VSCode work?
If not, is there an error in the developer console other than the InvalidStateError that popped up? (Ctrl+Shift+P > Developer: Toggle Developer Tools)
It looks like one of the errors is that it failed to update the Lean extension. What version are you on? I think 0.0.234 is the latest stable version

Hmm, this may be a VSCode issue - https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/125993 (vscode-lean4#206)
and people are saying that killing all the processes helps - killall -9 codium?

Update: this happened to me on macOS, with both the release and prerelease versions.
The devtools contain a bunch of [Extension Host] Document opened (isLeanDoc: false): ... even though I'm opening files in Mathlib and VSCode shows lean4 on the bottom right.
When I've hit this, it's been because of a stray code process as well
